import Port3_QueryStage
import Aeneas.Std.RangeIter

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.Port3_NativeRowFrame
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1Stage2
open Port3_RowsInstall (toBW fromBW toK)

def push (b : verifier.BatchedWeights) (j : Usize) (q : aspis_core.field.QM31) (m : U32) :
    Result verifier.BatchedWeights := do
  let out ← S7Kani2OwnedPush.push_owned (toBW b) j (toK q) m
  ok (fromBW out)

def install (ops : Port3_NativeQueryBody.Ops) : Port3_NativeQueryBody.Ops :=
  {ops with op14 := push}

theorem push_fields (b out : verifier.BatchedWeights) (j : Usize)
    (q : aspis_core.field.QM31) (m : U32) (bound : j.val<b.raw.val.length)
    (h : push b j q m=ok out) :
    out.raw.val.length=b.raw.val.length ∧ out.terms=b.terms := by
  unfold push at h
  obtain ⟨mid,run,h⟩ := Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ h
  have fields := Port3_PushFrame.push_fields (toBW b) mid j (toK q) m bound run
  cases Result.ok.inj h
  exact fields

/-- The actual native row body preserves the raw allocation and terms on a
successful active step, with its emitted wrapping trace offsets retained. -/
theorem body_fields (ops : Port3_NativeQueryBody.Ops)
    (v : alloc.vec.Vec aspis_core.field.QM31) (q : aspis_core.field.QM31)
    (next width : Usize) (basis : Array U32 256#usize)
    (iter : core.ops.range.Range Usize) (b : verifier.BatchedWeights)
    (active : iter.start.val < iter.end.val) (bound : iter.end.val≤b.raw.val.length)
    (out : ControlFlow (core.ops.range.Range Usize × verifier.BatchedWeights) verifier.BatchedWeights)
    (h : Port3_NativeQueryBody.verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1.body
      (install ops) v q next width basis iter b=ok out) :
    ∃ iter1 b1, out=cont (iter1,b1) ∧ iter1.start.val=iter.start.val+1 ∧
      iter1.end=iter.end ∧ b1.raw.val.length=b.raw.val.length ∧ b1.terms=b.terms := by
  obtain ⟨⟨o,iter1⟩,run,ho,hs,he⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next_UScalar_some_spec
      (ty:=.Usize) (cloneInst:=core.clone.CloneUsize)
      (partialOrdInst:=core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize) (by intro x; rfl) (by intro a b; rfl) iter active)
  subst o
  unfold Port3_NativeQueryBody.verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1.body at h
  rw [run] at h
  simp only [bind_tc_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨m,hm,h⟩ := Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ h
  obtain ⟨b1,hpush,h⟩ := Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ h
  have fields := push_fields b b1 iter.start q m (by omega) hpush
  iterate 9 obtain ⟨x,hx,h⟩ := Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ h
  exact ⟨iter1,b1,(Result.ok.inj h).symm,hs,he,fields⟩

#print axioms push_fields
#print axioms body_fields
end AspisR1.Port3_NativeRowFrame
end

S7Kani2OwnedPush.source:
import S7Kani2OwnedRow

/-! Exact emitted owned Vec push with its concrete Aeneas indexing/setter
semantics. No whole-Vec source equivalence or allocation premise is hidden. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace S7Kani2OwnedPush
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open S7Kani2AccumulatorLoop (BatchedWeights K)
open S7Kani2OwnedRow (Row residue_owned limb)

def push_owned (weights : BatchedWeights) (index : Usize) (power : K) (basis : U32) :
    Result BatchedWeights := do
  let row ← alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice (Array U64 4#usize)) weights.raw index
  let i ← lift (weights.terms &&& 3#usize)
  let updated ← residue_owned row power basis (i = 3#usize)
  let (_, index_mut_back) ← alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut
    (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice (Array U64 4#usize)) weights.raw index
  let v := index_mut_back updated
  ok {weights with raw := v}

/-- The emitted push is total on its bounded local row domain, and is exactly
one Vec.set. This exposes the complete frame, rather than only row values. -/
theorem push_total_frame (weights : BatchedWeights) (index : Usize) (power : K) (basis : U32)
    (hindex : index.val<weights.raw.length)
    (safe : ∀ row, alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice Row)
        weights.raw index=ok row →
      ∀ j raw, j.val<4 → Array.index_usize row j=ok raw →
        raw.val+(limb power j).val*basis.val<2^64) :
    ∃ row updated,
      push_owned weights index power basis = ok {weights with raw := weights.raw.set index updated} ∧
      alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice Row) weights.raw index=ok row ∧
      residue_owned row power basis ((weights.terms &&& 3#usize)=3#usize)=ok updated := by
  obtain ⟨row,hread,_⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize_spec weights.raw index hindex)
  have hr : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice Row)
      weights.raw index=ok row := hread
  obtain ⟨updated,hupdated⟩ := S7Kani2OwnedRow.row_total row power basis _ (safe row hr)
  obtain ⟨⟨old,back⟩,hmut,_,hback⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut_usize_spec weights.raw index hindex)
  have hm : alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice Row)
      weights.raw index = ok (old,back) := by
    rw [alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut_slice_index]
    exact hmut
  refine ⟨row,updated,?_,hr,hupdated⟩
  simp only [push_owned,hr,lift,bind_tc_ok,hupdated,hm,hback]
  rfl

#print axioms push_total_frame
end S7Kani2OwnedPush

S7Kani2OwnedRow.source:
import S7Kani2AccumulatorLoop
import S7OwnedP6ScalarProof

/- Literal emitted four-scalar row, ported only across the recorded structural
carrier renaming. Every array read and scalar operation is checked. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace S7Kani2OwnedRow
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisV8R17.RawReducer
abbrev K := S7Kani2AccumulatorLoop.K
abbrev Row := Array U64 4#usize

def limb (power : K) (j : Usize) : U32 :=
  if j=0#usize then power.c0.1 else if j=1#usize then power.c0.2
  else if j=2#usize then power.c1.1 else power.c1.2

def residue_owned
  (row : Array Std.U64 4#usize) (power : S7Kani2AccumulatorLoop.K)
  (basis : U32) (flush : Bool) :
  Result (Array Std.U64 4#usize)
  := do
  let i ← Array.index_usize row 0#usize
  let i1 := power.c0.1
  let i2 ← S7OwnedP6Scalar.residue_scalar_owned i i1 basis flush
  let i3 ← Array.index_usize row 1#usize
  let i4 := power.c0.2
  let i5 ← S7OwnedP6Scalar.residue_scalar_owned i3 i4 basis flush
  let i6 ← Array.index_usize row 2#usize
  let i7 := power.c1.1
  let i8 ← S7OwnedP6Scalar.residue_scalar_owned i6 i7 basis flush
  let i9 ← Array.index_usize row 3#usize
  let i10 := power.c1.2
  let i11 ← S7OwnedP6Scalar.residue_scalar_owned i9 i10 basis flush
  ok (Array.make 4#usize [ i2, i5, i8, i11 ])

/-- Total four-lane source execution, without arithmetic callee premises.
The local overflow invariant is explicit and supplied by phase_bound. -/
theorem row_total (row : Row) (power : K) (basis : U32) (flush : Bool)
    (safe : ∀ j raw, j.val<4 → Array.index_usize row j=ok raw →
      raw.val+(limb power j).val*basis.val<2^64) :
    ∃ out, residue_owned row power basis flush=ok out := by
  obtain ⟨r0,h0,_⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Array.index_usize_spec row 0#usize (by scalar_tac))
  obtain ⟨r1,h1,_⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Array.index_usize_spec row 1#usize (by scalar_tac))
  obtain ⟨r2,h2,_⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Array.index_usize_spec row 2#usize (by scalar_tac))
  obtain ⟨r3,h3,_⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Array.index_usize_spec row 3#usize (by scalar_tac))
  have s0 := safe 0#usize r0 (by decide) h0
  have s1 := safe 1#usize r1 (by decide) h1
  have s2 := safe 2#usize r2 (by decide) h2
  have s3 := safe 3#usize r3 (by decide) h3
  simp [limb] at s0 s1 s2 s3
  obtain ⟨x0,hx0,_⟩ := S7OwnedP6ScalarProof.scalar_success r0 power.c0.1 basis flush s0
  obtain ⟨x1,hx1,_⟩ := S7OwnedP6ScalarProof.scalar_success r1 power.c0.2 basis flush s1
  obtain ⟨x2,hx2,_⟩ := S7OwnedP6ScalarProof.scalar_success r2 power.c1.1 basis flush s2
  obtain ⟨x3,hx3,_⟩ := S7OwnedP6ScalarProof.scalar_success r3 power.c1.2 basis flush s3
  exact ⟨Array.make 4#usize [x0,x1,x2,x3],by simp [residue_owned,h0,h1,h2,h3,hx0,hx1,hx2,hx3]⟩

#print axioms row_total
end S7Kani2OwnedRow

S7OwnedP6ScalarExtracted.source:
import Aeneas

/- Exact declaration slice from the pinned Aeneas output. No backend axioms. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow Error
namespace S7OwnedP6Scalar
def residue_scalar_owned
  (raw1 : Std.U64) (limb : Std.U32) (basis : Std.U32) (flush : Bool) :
  Result Std.U64
  := do
  let i ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from limb)
  let i1 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from basis)
  let i2 ← i * i1
  let updated ← raw1 + i2
  if flush
  then
    let i3 ← lift (updated &&& 2147483647#u64)
    let i4 ← updated >>> 31#i32
    i3 + i4
  else ok updated


end S7OwnedP6Scalar

Port4D_FlushABI.source:
import Port3_NativeFlushBody
import Port3_FlushInstall
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.Port4D_FlushABI
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1Stage2
abbrev K := aspis_core.field.QM31
abbrev FinishIter := Port3_NativeFlushBody.Enum
abbrev FinishBack := FinishIter → FinishIter
abbrev FinishSlice := Slice K
abbrev FinishNextBack := FinishIter → Option (Usize × K) → FinishIter
abbrev FinishIterMut := core.slice.iter.IterMut K
/-- TrustedStd content interpretation of the current emitted mutable ABI.
The outer back closure consumes the final deferred back function. -/
def next (self : FinishIter) : Result (Option (Usize × K) × FinishIter × FinishNextBack) := do
  let (value, iter, back) ← core.slice.iter.IteratorIterMut.next self.iter
  match value with
  | none => ok (none, { self with iter }, fun current _ =>
      { current with iter := back current.iter none })
  | some value => do
    let count ← self.count + 1#usize
    ok (some (self.count, value), { iter, count }, fun current replacement =>
      { current with iter := back current.iter (replacement.map Prod.snd) })
def enumerate (iter : FinishIterMut) : Result (FinishIter × (FinishBack → FinishIterMut)) :=
  ok (⟨iter,0#usize⟩, fun back => (back ⟨iter,0#usize⟩).iter)
def std : Port3_NativeFlushBody.Ops := ⟨next,enumerate⟩
def prefixWrite (f : Nat → K) (start n : Nat) : FinishSlice → FinishSlice
  | s => match n with
    | 0 => s
    | k + 1 => prefixWrite f start k (if start ≤ k then s.setAtNat k (f k) else s)

theorem prefixWrite_before (f : Nat → K) (start n : Nat)
    (h : n ≤ start) (s : FinishSlice) : prefixWrite f start n s = s := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      simp only [prefixWrite]
      have hn : ¬ start ≤ n := by omega
      simp only [hn, ite_false]
      exact ih (by omega)

def BackPrefix (f : Nat → K) (start processed : Nat)
    (back : FinishBack) : Prop :=
  ∀ e : FinishIter, (back e).iter.slice = prefixWrite f start processed e.iter.slice

theorem backPrefix_id (f : Nat → K) (start : Nat) :
    BackPrefix f start start (fun e => e) := by
  intro e
  exact prefixWrite_before f start start (Nat.le_refl _) e.iter.slice |>.symm

theorem backPrefix_step (f : Nat → K)
    (start processed : Nat) (back : FinishBack) (index : Std.Usize)
    (nextBack : FinishIter → Option (Std.Usize × K) → FinishIter)
    (hback : BackPrefix f start processed back)
    (hindex : index.val = processed)
    (hstart : start ≤ processed)
    (hwrite : ∀ e : FinishIter,
      (nextBack e (some (index, f index.val))).iter.slice =
        e.iter.slice.setAtNat index.val (f index.val)) :
    BackPrefix f start (processed + 1)
      (fun e => back (nextBack e (some (index, f index.val)))) := by
  intro e
  rw [hback, hwrite]
  simp only [prefixWrite, if_pos hstart, hindex]

#print axioms prefixWrite_before
#print axioms backPrefix_id
#print axioms backPrefix_step
end AspisR1.Port4D_FlushABI
end
